items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: they had a cousin of mine who used to play drums with my dad. His name was Charlie Blue, Charlie Watson was his name

ctx.x: We'd be running to find that in it.

And, so, some of them wouldn't have the well-borne, they'd have that little, we used to call it iron, it wasn't iron, no, it was that thin thin steel like the well-borne in it. But, man, when we'd find that well-borne, oh shoot, we had pitched the last of the house. Took a free year. Yeah. But, we had, now they had a cousin of mine who used to play drums with my dad. His name was Charlie Blue, Charlie Watson was his name, we used to call him Charlie Blue. Oh, he was a great drummer, he was great. And, well, he…
When did your daddy quit playing?
